reason: A slash-command plugin that reviews recent Git changes, proposes focused code simplifications, limits edits to changed lines, and runs existing tests.

summaries.zh: 这是一个通过 /simplify 审查 Git 最近改动、在改动范围内提出代码简化并运行现有测试的插件。
summaries.en: A plugin that reviews recent Git changes, suggests focused code simplifications within changed ranges, and runs existing project tests.

capabilities: Reads Git diffs and changed line ranges
Reads surrounding source code for context
Edits files within identified changed ranges
Runs existing project tests through the shell
Follows project instructions from CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md
